titles.JP: フラッシュウェーブ：サマーレース

sequence: 滨海极速：夏日狂飙  海风、镜头与引擎声！

scripts.say: 夕阳尚未完全落下，赛道、看台，还有悬挂在高处的灯带与旗帜，一同在晚霞中闪闪发亮。
受本宁顿邀请而来的我，发现“落日大道6小时耐力赛”的预热演出，显然已经开始了一段时间。
Hi——指挥官！欢迎回到我的频道！
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 熟悉的开场白从身后传来，还没等我反应，她就一把拉住我的手，朝会场中央跑去。
等等，本宁顿——
你已经来晚了哦~预热演出都开始好一会儿了。
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 再等下去，今天素材的价值可是会大打折扣的~
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 本宁顿举着相机，一边倒退着拍摄，一边熟练地拉着我穿过入口。
活动特别企划——《夏日狂飙》先导篇，正式开拍！
主角、场地、夕阳、海风……嗯，全部到位！
只有开场够热闹，后面的视频点击才会高——这是常识哦，指挥官~
灯光随着音乐的节拍不断切换，台下的气氛早已被彻底点燃。
聚光灯下，作为特邀主持嘉宾登台的维克斯堡注意到我的到来后，立刻用力地朝我挥了挥手中的旗帜。
爱心~闪耀~Lucky Power~♪
伴随着轻快的鼓点与应援声，活跃的维克斯堡立刻让现场气氛热烈了起来。
喔哦~这种感觉真的超棒啊~
海风、夕阳、音乐、欢呼……这才叫夏天嘛！
所以你是来看演出的，还是来做节目的？
没差别啦~
在享受生活的同时记录生活，是我这个Vlogger的本能哦~
大家晚上好——！欢迎来到“落日大道6小时耐力赛”预热之夜！
舞台灯光忽然由绚烂的暖色收束成一道笔直的白光，中央大屏也切换成了赛道俯瞰画面与赛事标识。
维克斯堡踩着轻快的步伐登上主持台，朝四周看台用力挥了挥手。
在正式介绍本次比赛的赛道之前，我有一个惊喜要告诉大家！
为了让更多人亲身体验耐力赛的魅力，今年赛事还特别增加了「公开体验车队」！
只要在今晚完成预报名，再通过后续的基础车辆检查和车手登记——
就有机会亲自驶上这条赛道，去感受风、速度，还有和专业车手同场竞技的心跳时刻！
说不定——真的有人能从她们手中夺走冠军奖杯哦？
所以，如果有谁已经开始心跳加速、热血沸腾的话，现在就可以鼓起勇气行动啦~！
好厉害~罗杰斯这么喜欢赛车，一定很想参加比赛吧？
……哈？我、我只是陪姐姐你过来随便看看而已，别突然说这种话啊！
和身边躁动的人群一样，本宁顿也瞬间兴奋了起来。
喂喂~指挥官，你听到了吗？这可是绝好的机会啊！
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 你就不想上场感受一下吗？
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 我还在犹豫，听到本宁顿这番话的哈里森和约翰·罗杰斯已经凑了过来。
欸，是指挥官？
啊——指挥官也在！还有本宁顿小姐~
你们也想报名参加比赛吗？
“也”是怎么回事啦，我可没说过想参加！
我们又不会开车，组建车队什么的……怎么可能……
本宁顿显然也注意到了这一幕，立刻敏锐地把镜头凑到了我面前。
我正好记得——指挥官你会开车吧？
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 是会一点点，但我这次只是来旅游的……想休息一下……
不冲突啦~难得遇到这么刺激的比赛，不亲自参与一下未免有些可惜哦！
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 听到这里，约翰·罗杰斯像是终于下定了决心一般，快步走到了我的面前。
指挥官，我、我先说明——
我不是被现场气氛影响了，一时冲动才这么说。
我是……认真思考过后，觉得这件事值得试试。
嘿嘿，我也会一起帮忙的哦~
咳咳……总之，就是这样。
你、你要是不愿意也没关系。我只是提议一下而已，也不是非要你——
听起来很有意思。
临时组队参赛么……
好，那我们去报名吧！
……这就下决定了？！
太好了~！
Nice——这才对嘛！夏日、赛道、临时参赛的挑战者，这种展开才够精彩！
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 那现在，该为我们的车队取一个名字了——来，指挥官，对着镜头说出你的答案！
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 就叫{car2026}怎么样？
嗯嗯，这名字，还挺像样的。
名字很好听哦，指挥官~
那就这么定了！{car2026}车队——诞生！我已经开始期待它出现在计分板上了！
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

sequence: 滨海极速：夏日狂飙  状况百出？车队启程！

scripts.say: Hi~欢迎来到本宁顿的新企划！指挥官的夏日狂飙▷
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 本宁顿，慢点……这里可不是赛道。
伴随着一个漂亮得有些夸张的甩尾入位，本宁顿把车停进了报名后分配给我们的临时维修位。
指挥官！这边！
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 约翰·罗杰斯已经等候多时了，旁边的哈里森将饮水、工具箱、记录板和各类杂物补充完全。
我的心中突然产生了一种“她们说不定真的很专业”的感觉。
指挥官，你们来啦~
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 我们想着既然决定要参赛，就把可能会用到的东西都尽量提前准备好了……
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 嗯嗯，这后勤配置已经很像样了。
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 我宣布，{car2026}车队的后方支援系统正式成立！
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 这种事情不用你宣布啦！
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 虽然嘴上这样说着，但她明显比刚才多了几分底气。
参赛流程我已经确认了。
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 预报名、车辆检查、车手登记……只要在排位赛前把资料补齐，我们就能正式拿到体验车队的资格。
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 看来你已经进入状态了。
那、那当然！都走到这一步了，总不能真让别人觉得我们只是来凑热闹的吧。
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 我接过约翰·罗杰斯递来的报名单，开始逐项检查，一个最现实的问题突然摆到了我面前。
等等……我们的车辆登记栏还空着。
啊……车？
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 这……以我和罗杰斯的动手能力，还是有点勉强……
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 约翰·罗杰斯迟疑了一下，有些心虚地看向了停在维修位上本宁顿的车，这是目前我们唯一的四轮载具了。
嗯哼~看我干嘛？我一来就把它开进你们的维修位里了哦~
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 你早就计划好了么？
Bingo！昨天指挥官动心的时候我就预料到这个状况了~
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 我的爱车可是经过赛事级改装——临时客串一下参赛车辆完全没问题！
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 虽然和我想象中的有些出入……不过也算是满足参赛条件了！
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 指挥官，我们先跑一圈如何？
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 嗯嗯，车辆的实际表现、赛道的路感，还有哪里需要调整……这些都得提前摸清楚才行~
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 好，就让我试着把第一圈跑出来吧~
就这样，在多少有些仓促的准备之后，我们的{car2026}车队终于开始真正运转起来。

sequence: 滨海极速：夏日狂飙  新手车队的强援！

scripts.say: 试车首圈，我并未急于试探极限，而是将节奏放缓，在熟悉赛道之余感受车辆的质感。
未经改装和调校的基础赛车各项性能都偏保守。试跑结束后，我将车重新开回了维修区。
很漂亮的试车呢！指挥官辛苦了，先喝点水吧~
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 怎么样？能跑吗？
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 能跑，不过也有一些问题。
我接过水，一边回忆着刚才试跑时的手感，一边列举了一些直观的反馈。
……指挥官，你像是在形容一辆红色拖拉机！
车辆本身很好，只是离“能上赛道比赛”的状态，还有小小的距离。
听起来比预想中还要麻烦呢……
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 嗯，已经不是外行能应对的了……
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 所以，我们要想继续跑下去的话，就缺一个能看懂这些问题、也知道该怎么调整的人？
没错，我们缺一位真正的赛车工程师。
约翰·罗杰斯皱着眉，像是想起了什么似的，表情变得有些微妙。
喔哦——经典展开！你是不是准备说，“其实我认识一个说不定能派上用场的人”？
……虽然不想承认你说的话，但好像真有一个人选。
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 真的吗？那太好了！
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 先、先说好，我也不是百分之百确定！
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 就是之前偶然听她提过一些改装啊、调校啊之类的东西，讲得头头是道……应该，算是很懂吧？
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 应该？
算是？
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 吧？
你们那是什么反应啊！我都说了不能确定的！
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 既然眼下没有更好的办法……要不就去确认下对方能不能帮上忙吧？
对对对，万一真的能帮上忙呢~
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 危机出现，外援线索浮现——这下Vlog剧情的节奏彻底起来了！
别把这种事讲得像你提前写好的剧本一样啊！
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

sequence: 滨海极速：夏日狂飙  误打误撞的技术支援

scripts.say: 新朋友们，老朋友们，早上好中午好晚上好~
本宁顿将镜头扫过后勤区入口，紧接着框住了正在前方带路的约翰·罗杰斯。
经过刚才的试跑，我们的赛车暴露出了不少问题——现在急需一名专业的工程师的加入！
于是在罗杰斯的带领下，我们来到了赛道旁洗车场……唔，确实很有电影里世外高人的感觉呢~
你、你先把镜头放下……我只是说她懂赛车调教，可没说是什么世外高人！
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 在观众面前谦虚可没用哦~
我们沿着一排排等待清洗的车辆向里走去，没过多久，就在最里面的一辆赛车前停下了脚步。
一位明显已经睡着的少女正被一台大型无人机晃悠悠地吊在车顶上，手中的水枪有一下没一下地扫过车壳。
scripts.actorName: 柯莱特 [飞高高的“自动”洗车法]

scripts.say: 柯莱特……？她会调校赛车？
应、应该会吧……
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 她这样吊着……真的没问题吗？
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 还是先把人叫醒吧。
我走上前去，试着叫了她一声。
柯莱特……？快醒醒。
对方完全没有反应，无人机倒是先一步转动镜头，对准了我们。
Error十三世为您服务……访客识别中。
确认最高优先级目标——指挥官，执行唤醒任务。
无人机轻微震动了一下。片刻后，柯莱特终于慢吞吞地抬起头，一脸还没完全醒来的茫然。
……唔……赛车都洗完了？
你总算醒了。
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: ……罗杰斯？
她眨了眨眼，视线从约翰·罗杰斯身上缓缓移到我们这边，最后又落在了本宁顿手里的镜头上。
……采访的话，不接。
遗憾，我还以为能挖到世外高人的幕后故事呢~
……你们就是来问这个的吗？
柯莱特，你是不是很熟悉赛车的调校？
闻言，柯莱特沉默了几秒，然后摇了摇头。
我没有调校过真的赛车……
欸？那你常说的那些术语是……
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 最近，正好在玩一款赛车改装模拟游戏……所以时常会研究改装方案。
误会被拆穿后，气氛一时间变得有些微妙。
但比起立刻失望离开，我反而从她刚才的话里抓住了另一个重点。
调校优化不行……但如果只是根据车辆反馈进行数据分析呢？
柯莱特抬头看着我，这次，她没有立刻否认。
……这个可以。
如果只是根据车辆反馈、赛道特性、轮胎状态这些去做参数分析……我能胜任。
也就是说，我们的车还有救？
前提是车况别太糟。
如果只是基础车，很多问题都能靠数据调整去改善。
那就够了。
柯莱特，加入我们{car2026}车队吧。我们现在正缺一位能做数据分析和车辆调校的人。
听到这句话后，柯莱特缓缓放下手中的器材，挥手示意无人机把自己放到我面前。
可以……只是，别安排太多需要说话的工作。
没问题。欢迎加入！
嘿嘿，这下终于有点真正车队的样子了~
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 呼……虽然过程跟我想的完全不一样，但结果至少是好的。
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: “{car2026}车队求援成功，神秘工程师正式加入！”新一期Vlog的标题就用这个吧！
就这样，我们带着这位意料之外的新成员，踏上了返回维修区的路。

sequence: 滨海极速：夏日狂飙  假日的邀约

scripts.say: Hello各位观众，欢迎回到我的频道！指挥官的狂飙之旅继续——
她侧身让开，镜头对准维修区的一角，柯莱特正抱着平板窝在工具箱上。
大家看到了吧？在柯莱特的帮助下，我们的赛车调校已经逐渐步入正轨啦！
不过——虽然调校有起色了，新的问题也已经浮出水面了哦！
新的问题……有么？
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 当然有啦！6小时的耐力赛可不是一位车手就能跑完的，我们还需要一位轮换车手~
是和指挥官一样的赛车手吗……？
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 准确地说，最好是有经验的职业赛车手。
哼哼，说到这个……巧了~
本宁顿像是专门等着这一刻似的，唇角一扬，露出了那种“我早就知道”的神情。
你有推荐人选？
哼哼哼~我正巧知道，埃塞克斯现在就在会场附近的酒店度假哦。
她没有参赛么？
大概是和你一样想休息休息吧~不过如果是指挥官的邀请，她肯定会乐意加入我们的。
我现在去联系她。
好耶，出发——下一阶段的主题是，海风、假日与职业车手！
离开维修区后，我们沿着会场外侧的观景步道向海边酒店走去。
傍晚的日光比先前柔和了许多，等我来到酒店的露天泳池旁时，果然在那里看见了一道熟悉的身影。
……指挥官？
看来本宁顿的消息没错，你果然在这里。
指挥官，现在可是休息时间……你不会是来拉我去工作的吧？
怎么会呢。我是来度假的，你也是来度假的，我们应该做点度假时该做的事情，对吧？
///度假时该做的事情是、是指……？
是工作。我想邀请你加入我的{car2026}车队。
那种事情不可以——啊……？指挥官的……车队？
见她有些惊讶，我便说出了前情。
天台的风不急不缓地吹着，伴随着我的述说，埃塞克斯原本有些气鼓鼓的表情逐渐变得认真起来。
原来如此。
你们的车队想真正和那些准备充分的队伍较量，确实还差一位能稳定节奏、判断局势的专业车手。
没错。我相信，你与我们队伍的节奏完全契合。
埃塞克斯没有回话，只是看着我，像是在确认我这句话里的认真程度。
我接受邀请，以轮换车手的身份加入你们。
当然，我答应加入，可不是来陪你们“尽力而为”的。
既然上了赛道，就要以更高的目标为前提去准备。
无论是节奏、配合，还是驾驶分工，我都会按照夺冠的标准要求。
正合我意。
呵呵，你果然会这么回答。
她向我走近一步，任由我将她拉上岸边。
走吧，去赛道。
既然决定加入，就从现在开始进入状态。
夕阳在她身后的水面上投下细碎的光，为这一刻添上了一层几乎不真实的亮色。
而我们的{car2026}车队，也终于补上了最后，也是最为关键的一块拼图。

sequence: 滨海极速：夏日狂飙  目标——杆位！

scripts.say: 距离排位赛正式开始，只剩下最后一点准备时间。
在所有小队成员的努力下，我们的赛车终于进入了相对稳定的状态。
悬架、刹车、轮胎工作区间……我都记下来了。
还有别的调整么？
有。差速器也按我的习惯调校了，设定更激进一些，出弯时可以更早、更猛地给油。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 不过代价是，如果动作太粗暴，也会更快把轮胎吃掉。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 也就是说，排位赛可以跑得更激进一些，但圈速窗口很短。
对……极限状态下只能撑一两圈，再多轮胎状态就会飞快往下掉。
Hi——各位辛苦啦！
带着熟悉的轻快开场，本宁顿元气十足的声音从门口传来。
你们最靠谱、最有审美、并且对爱车拥有合法探视权的车主本宁顿，前来探班！
看车？你是来拍素材的才对吧？
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 当然是两者兼顾~幕后记录、赛前花絮、技术升级——这可都是绝佳的视频素材。
让我看看，让我看看——我亲爱的宝贝现在被你们改造成什么样了？
她把镜头探向驾驶位，正想继续发表感想，却忽然顿了一下。
嗯……？这个小东西，原本就在这里吗？
众人的目光顺着她所指的位置看去，只见仪表盘上，不知什么时候多出了一个小小的像素风电子宠物。
Hi！小家伙——
嘀——识别到语音唤醒。
Error十三世，启动中——

scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 等一下，这是什么？！
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 哇——这也太可爱了吧？
这是我的电子宠物，你们可以把它当成一个可视化的提示模块。
用途是辅助监测车况、提示预设阈值，还能做简单语音提醒……
往赛车里装这种东西，真的没问题吗？！
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 安心。我确认过规则，只要没有接入车辆控制权限，就不违反赛事规则。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 嗯，我还为Error十三世设置了盛大的庆祝礼，不过要夺冠才能解锁。
夺冠啊，那我可要加油了。
So cool！车队的胜利宣言，我要拍的就是这个！
本宁顿一脸兴奋地举起镜头，对着我们和仪表盘上的Error十三世连录了好几段。
很好！从现在开始，你就是{car2026}车队的吉祥物了。
嘀——确认新身份，接受夸奖。
心情值UP！
车库外，广播声再次响起，排位赛的检录时间到了。
原本因为意外插曲而短暂松动的紧张感，重新回到了每个人心里。
该出发了。
支援就绪，我和罗杰斯随时可以为指挥官提供帮助哦！
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 数据链路正常，监测界面正常。
嘀——全系统待命。
指挥官先手，去跑出最漂亮的一圈吧！
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 从最初的仓促组队，到如今终于站在排位赛前，{car2026}车队已经承载了远比预想更多的东西。
每一个人投注在这里的心意——都将在接下来的赛道上被一并验证。
那就出发吧。
目标——杆位。

sequence: 滨海极速：夏日狂飙  排位赛开始！

scripts.say: 维修区外，赛道广播与引擎轰鸣彼此交叠，原本就躁动不安的空气，在这一刻被彻底点燃。
落日大道两侧的看台上传来一阵接一阵的欢呼，灯光、旗帜与镜头一同转向赛道。
而我们，也终于来到了这场较量真正开始的时刻。
这里是主持人关岛，落日大道6小时耐力赛排位赛即将开始！
今天谁能拿下这宝贵的杆位呢？
是沉稳老练的企业选手？
是敏捷强势的瑞鹤选手？
还是本场的黑马，我们的新人车手——指挥官！
来吧，在比赛开始前，把最热烈的欢呼声送给所有车手！
赛道上方，五盏绿灯依次点亮，所有的赛车同时启动发车。
指挥官听得到吗？
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 听得很清楚。
赛车监测数据传输正常。
指挥官，你是第一次参赛，先别急着做成绩，按计划完成暖胎，把车和赛道都熟悉一遍。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 好。
我轻轻压下油门，让赛车以接近极限、却还留有余地的姿态掠过一个又一个弯角。
方向盘的回馈、轮胎的咬地感、悬架在路肩上的弹跳——这些天在这里跑下的每一圈，此刻都在脑海中迅速重叠。
风向开始偏了。
柯莱特的声线也难得带上些起伏，让我本能地提高了注意力。
西北侧风速正在爬升，比预计提早了将近21分钟。
原本气象台给出的结论，是半小时后云层才会完全压过来，出现明显的侧风。
城市赛道的风会在高楼间形成复杂的乱流，带来很大的变数。
指挥官，注意赛道的气流变化。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 收到。
随着排位赛时间的推进，赛道上所有人的速度都在不断提高。
油量依旧在可控范围内，轮胎也还没到最佳窗口，但气象的变化让局势迅速紧张起来。
要提前释放圈数了。
再等下去，风只会越来越大。
哇哦——圈速榜正在疯狂刷新！
企业刚刚跑出了非常强势的一圈，瑞鹤也紧追在后，不挠稳居第三——
而我们的指挥官，也还在不断逼近前列！
今天的排位赛，比想象中还要激烈！

sequence: 滨海极速：夏日狂飙  风的王牌

scripts.say: 时间一点点流逝。
二十分钟过去后，赛道上空的云层已经明显压低，原本明亮的路面也渐渐失去光泽。
瑞鹤，风开始乱了，先别冒进。
只是排位赛，保持住现在的成绩就好。
嗯，我知道了，翔鹤姐。
风速还在继续增强，在某些高速弯前，赛车甚至会出现肉眼可见的轻微摆动。
侧风峰值变大了，二号计时段最明显。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 现在进弯时的修正幅度，比10分钟前大了接近百分之十。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 所有人都会开始保守起来，接下来还能不能做圈，不只看车，也看判断。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 就在这时，我冲过了终点线，计时屏上新的全场最快圈速跳了出来。
最快圈速更新。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 2:00.135，打破了落日大道耐力赛圈速记录！
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 但这道成绩只停留了极短的一瞬，下一秒，更快的数字便立刻将它取代。
再更新——
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 1:59.977，企业，第9圈做出的成绩。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 1:59.977！企业率先闯入1分59秒领域！
这已经是目前全场无人能及的标杆成绩了！
我深吸了一口气，稍稍放缓节奏。
还差一点，明明只是不到0.2秒的差距，却如同一道锋利的线将所有人挡在了后面。
但我也明白，现在的风已经不是单纯“再拼一点”就能解决的问题。
如果在最后阶段因为逞强把车送出赛道，那前面的所有准备都会失去意义……我尝试如此告诉自己。
油量剩余20%，轮胎抓地力达到峰值。
埃塞克斯，时间还剩下多少？
最后十分钟。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 指挥官，现在天气发生变化，风力已经能明显影响到赛车操控。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 我知道她说得完全没错，此刻继续冲击杆位，本身就是一种十分冒险的举动。
但我不想在这里直接放弃。
如果还有窗口，我想再试一次。
车队频道里短暂安静了一瞬，埃塞克斯的声音重新响起。
注意安全，保存好轮胎，柯莱特会为你捕捉最后的窗口。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 收到。
就在此时，另一条车队频道中，也有人注意到了这边的变化。
Honey……还真是不怕风啊~
scripts.actorName: 新泽西 [漆黑的超极速前奏]

scripts.say: 不是不怕，指挥官在等最后的窗口，等一个绝无仅有的超过我的机会。
那你还这么冷静？
scripts.actorName: 新泽西 [漆黑的超极速前奏]

scripts.say: 如果排在后面的是我，我也会这么做。
赛道上，越来越多的车辆开始主动降速。
在大风中守住已经做出的圈速，本来就是正确策略。
也正因为如此——我所在的这台仍在继续提速的赛车，才显得格外醒目。
等等、等等！
不是所有车手都选择了保守收尾！
指挥官还在加速！
在排位赛最后阶段，在风势最不稳定的时候——指挥官还想再做一个飞驰圈！
Go ahead！拿到杆位吧，指挥官！
我盯着前方，听长直道上的风贴着车身尖啸而过。
突然，那股持续的“拉扯感”变轻了，剧烈的横风被新的气流切开，形成了一个短暂的窗口。
就是现在！
这一圈会决定成败！冲吧，指挥官——
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 我猛地踩下油门，升档，全油门。
借着风势，我让车身在极限边缘贴着风掠过每一个弯道。
指挥官过得非常快！
还在加速！还在追！
进入连续高速弯——等等，指挥官的车尾被乱流推了一下！
能救回来吗？！
我本能般反打修正，极限开油，整台车在出弯时微微一摆。
救回来了！出弯！冲线——！
嘀——目标完成。

scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 干得漂亮，指挥官。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 听到埃塞克斯的声音，我缓缓松开油门，任由赛车沿着赛道继续向前滑去。
心跳仍在剧烈起伏，手上也还残留着刚才与风角力时的紧绷感。
A big W！真是让人心潮澎湃的结局！
在所有人都以为排位赛大局已定的时候，指挥官完成了最后的逆转！
今天的杆位，属于真正的王牌！

sequence: 滨海极速：夏日狂飙  正赛开幕！

scripts.say: 天还没有完全亮透，{car2026}车队的成员们就已经来到维修区，开始为这场六小时耐力赛做最后准备。
很好，准备得差不多了……啊，车手巡游快开始了，指挥官，我们走吧？
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 好。
因为昨天排位赛拿下杆位，我们的赛车被安排在发车区最显眼的位置。
维克斯堡，闪亮登场——！欢迎来到落日大道6小时耐力赛正赛现场！
虽然昨天的排位赛已经很精彩了，不过今天才是真正分胜负的时候哦！
接下来是——选手登场环节！让我们一起为她们和指挥官加油吧，好运一定会眷顾赛场上的大家！
镜头在一名名车手身上扫过，企业、瑞鹤、不挠……都是实力强劲的车手组合。
而当镜头转到我们这边时，看台边缘忽然爆发出一阵格外响亮的呼喊。
指挥官——！这里！这里！
加油啊！
指挥官，无论成绩如何，我都会在采访区等你的！
scripts.actorName: 阿尔弗雷多·奥里亚尼 [华丽的Vivace]

scripts.say: 哇——看台这边的应援声好夸张！
看来所有人都在期待，指挥官能不能把昨天的闪耀继续延续到正赛之中！
随着看台上的欢呼声，巡游区域另一侧，几位今天最值得警惕的对手也投来了视线。
Honey~昨天的最后一圈可真是让人印象深刻。
scripts.actorName: 新泽西 [漆黑的超极速前奏]

scripts.say: 不过正赛可不是排位赛哦~
scripts.actorName: 新泽西 [漆黑的超极速前奏]

scripts.say: 六小时的比赛，光靠一口气可跑不下来。
scripts.actorName: 新泽西 [漆黑的超极速前奏]

scripts.say: 新泽西。
好啦好啦，我只是提醒一下嘛~
scripts.actorName: 新泽西 [漆黑的超极速前奏]

scripts.say: 指挥官……昨天那一圈很精彩。
但今天的比赛，考验的是节奏、判断和耐心。
如果你想赢，就不能只想着“快”。
我明白。
另一边，瑞鹤姐妹也走了过来。
指挥官，这次正赛我可不会再输给你了！
我们会全力以赴的。
呵呵~一起努力吧，指挥官~
巡游结束后，所有赛车陆续回到发车位，随后暖胎圈起步。
作为头车，我可以自由地走线，不用顾忌超车和追尾等问题。
通讯正常。
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 轮胎温度正常。
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 风速稳定。
指挥官，你拿到了最好的发车位置。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 暖胎圈结束后，只要起步别出大问题，就能率先进入一号弯避免拥挤。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 但记住，不要在第一圈就把自己逼到绝境。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 今天不是短跑，留到最后的人才能赢。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 明白。
大家好，我是赛事解说本宁顿，现在所有赛车即将完成暖胎圈！
落日大道6小时耐力赛——
1——GoGoGo！
比赛开始！
红灯熄灭，整条发车直道仿佛在一瞬间炸开，数十台赛车同时咆哮着向前冲去——

sequence: 滨海极速：夏日狂飙  经验的差距！

scripts.say: 起步很干净，拥挤的一号弯近在眼前。
我提前占住内线，减速点控制得刚好，赛车在一片刹车烟尘与引擎嘶吼中切进弯心。
身后几辆车几乎贴着我的尾翼通过，所有人都在抢占位置，但至少这一刻，我还守在最前面。
漂亮！
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 一号弯安全通过！
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 很好，继续按自己的节奏跑。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 起跑后的前几圈，我始终把赛车维持在相对稳定的区间。
不去做过于激进的防守，也不把轮胎浪费在没有必要的细小拉扯上。
然而，正赛和排位赛终究不同。
一圈之内该快到什么程度、该在哪里节省轮胎、什么时候利用车流、什么时候放弃纠缠保住节奏……
经验、耐心与对长距离节奏的把控，开始一点一点显出重量。
企业出手了！
她抓住了出弯牵引更好的机会，在长直道尾端完成了超越！
瑞鹤也紧跟而上！
啊啊，这就是正赛啊，哪怕起步领先，想守住位置也没那么容易！
企业的动作果断而精准，没有浪费任何一处可利用的路段。
瑞鹤则像盯住破绽的刀锋，在我的防守被迫收窄的瞬间，从另一侧迅速切了过去。
而不挠并没有贸然加入争抢，她只是继续稳稳跟住，等待最适合的时机。
长距离比赛中，经验丰富的人总能在每一圈都多拿走一点时间。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 指挥官，我们现在要做的是……
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 稳住心态。
没错。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 但局势并没有因此好转。
一次防守，两次路线让位，因为在对轮胎和车流的处理上缺乏经验，我渐渐被前面的车手甩开。
比赛进行到一个半小时后，场上局势已经发生了明显变化！
昨天拿下杆位的指挥官，在正赛长距离的较量中，开始逐渐被那些经验丰富的强队压制住了！
虽然指挥官仍然留在第一集团边缘，但局面已经变得相当被动！
当我再次驶过主看台时，大屏幕上的排名定格在第六。
杆位发车带来的短暂光芒，被漫长的比赛冲刷殆尽。
但也就在这一刻，我反而彻底冷静了下来。
我终于明白了一件事——这不是我一个人的比赛。

sequence: 滨海极速：夏日狂飙  团队的意义！追击时刻

scripts.say: 第一次进站结束后，驾驶席上的人，换成了埃塞克斯。
与我相比，她的动作更简洁，节奏也更稳定。
换胎完成！
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 出站、出站、出站！
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 收到。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 赛车重新冲出维修区的那一刻，我站在屏幕前，第一次以场边的视角去看这场比赛。
{car2026}车队完成了车手更换！
13.1秒，相当不错的成绩！现在接管赛车的是——埃塞克斯！
她拥有着非常稳定的长距离能力，不知道这一次，她能不能替车队扭转局面？
答案，很快就来了。
埃塞克斯并没有一上来就做出多么夸张的超车，只是紧紧跟在前方车辆后面。
可只要出现半个车身的破绽，她就一定会从那个缺口里穿过去。
柯莱特，告诉我前车在二号段的速度变化，她应该很长时间没进站了。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 已经在掉了！
好，那我不会在一号弯动手。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 等她出三号弯牵引变差的时候，我再过去。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 听起来好可怕……
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 埃塞克斯再次超车成功！
她没有像某些激进派一样每个弯都要拼命贴上去，却能在每一圈都稳稳吃掉前车的时间！
听到本宁顿的解说声，约翰·罗杰斯也在维修区点起了头。
嗯，没错没错。
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 你真的看懂了吗？
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 当然！
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 你看，她这个走线就非常……专业。
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 确实很稳。
而且还很快。
柯莱特将手中的平板递了过来，埃塞克斯正在一圈一圈地把差距磨掉。
嗯~这可真是出乎意料。
scripts.actorName: 新泽西 [漆黑的超极速前奏]

scripts.say: 企业，你的后辈在赛道上追得很快嘛~
scripts.actorName: 新泽西 [漆黑的超极速前奏]

scripts.say: 她很清楚自己该在什么时候用力。
我会和后车拉开更远的距离。
比赛进入后半程时，埃塞克斯已经把车带回到了前列。
主看台的大屏幕上，我们的排名一格一格上升，维修区里的气氛也逐渐被重新点燃。
追回来了！
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 再往前，就只剩下瑞鹤和企业……还有一直跑得相当稳定的不挠。
现在比赛进入最精彩的阶段了！
埃塞克斯已经杀进第一集团，前面的车队是不挠！
哦~不挠果断让开了道路，埃塞克斯顺势向前方的瑞鹤发起进攻！
两台赛车之间的距离越来越近——这是第二名之争，也是通往冠军的关键一步！
埃塞克斯没有急着正面硬碰，借着瑞鹤的尾流，准备利用弹弓效应在下个长直道末端轻松超越她。
居然跟得这么紧，不行！不能就这样被她超过去！
前面还有灰色幽灵在等着……
呼……那就试试吧！
瑞鹤察觉到了埃塞克斯的意图，下一个高速弯前，两台车同时加速。
现在双方的速度都已逼近极限！喔哦——瑞鹤又把速度往上提了一点，她成功守住了线路！
瑞鹤今天状态奇佳啊，她还在压！
在轮胎衰退的情况下表现依旧强势！
砰——瑞鹤的车胎突然爆开，在弯心外侧猛地滑出赛道，卷起大片尘土。
她没有选择——等等，等等！
爆胎了！瑞鹤冲出了赛道！
埃塞克斯灵巧地避开了前方的碎屑，成功超了过去！
啊……果然还是不行么……
我们升到了第二位，可喜悦只维持了很短一瞬。
因为几乎同一时间，柯莱特已经盯着屏幕，皱起了眉。
埃塞克斯，我们的轮胎磨损……也接近极限了。
再跑下去，不仅圈速会大幅衰减，还有爆胎风险。
我知道，但现在如果进站，会被企业拉开很大的差距。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 就在这时，赛道上忽然响起了赛会提示音。
VSC，VSC。
全赛道虚拟安全车程序启动。
VSC？！
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 是刚才瑞鹤爆胎时的碎片！
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 这是最好的进站时机。
现在进，损失会被压到最低。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 所有人的目光都落到了我身上。
因为现在只剩一个问题——谁来跑完最后的时间。
短暂沉默后，埃塞克斯先开口了。
指挥官，你上吧！
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 我相信你。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 我已经把差距追回来了，也把这台车带回了能争冠的位置。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 但前面是企业前辈，指挥官……最后的攻坚，只有你能做到。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

CN.title: 千分之一秒的冠军奇迹！

sequence: 滨海极速：夏日狂飙  千分之一秒的冠军奇迹！

scripts.say: VSC期间，我们完成了最后一次关键进站。
换胎、补给、车手轮换——所有动作都在最短时间内完成。
完美的进站！
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 位置确认，仍在第二！
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 前面的企业也完成了进站！
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 收到。
VSC结束，比赛恢复。
最后阶段的冠军争夺正式开始！
领跑者是企业，而紧跟其后的——正是重新上场的指挥官！
双方的差距已经非常小了，这场六小时耐力赛的胜负，很可能就要在最后这段时间里决定！
企业的防守没有半点急躁。
她不会为了卡住我而做出多余动作，也不会在不必要的位置消耗轮胎。
正因为这样，每一次想要接近她，都比想象中更难。
后车很快，上面不是埃塞克斯？
是Honey~已经追上来了~
scripts.actorName: 新泽西 [漆黑的超极速前奏]

scripts.say: 怎么样，有压力吗？
scripts.actorName: 新泽西 [漆黑的超极速前奏]

scripts.say: 但我不会让指挥官过去。
一圈又一圈，练习中积累下来的赛道记忆被一点点唤醒。
哪里可以更晚刹车，哪里出弯可以更早开油……
那些曾经在无数练习圈里反复试错得来的东西，此刻终于拼合成了一条完整的线路。
指挥官，企业在六号弯会习惯性地保护轮胎。
出弯速度略慢，下一圈可以试试。
我深吸一口气。下一圈，机会果然来了。
出弯牵引的一瞬间，我比上一圈更早踩下油门。
赛车像被释放出的箭一样冲出弯角，迅速贴到企业身后。
在进入下一个制动区之前，我猛地抽向外侧，随后切回内线。
企业被迫晚了半拍修正，而我则借着那一瞬间的空档，把车头送了进去。
进去了！
指挥官完成超越！
最后阶段，领先位置发生交换！
哎呀，居然真的过去了。
scripts.actorName: 新泽西 [漆黑的超极速前奏]

scripts.say: ……做得不错。
不过，比赛还没结束。
接下来几圈，企业继续冷静地跟在后面，等待着捕捉我可能犯下的微小失误。
比赛时间一点点流逝。
当场边显示进入最后一圈时，我和企业之间依然只差不到半个车身。
最后一圈！
落日大道6小时耐力赛，进入最后一圈！
冠军将在企业与指挥官之间决出！
两台赛车现在几乎是贴在一起的！
差距不到半个车身了……别让她超过去啊！
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 可我们的轮胎……已经衰减到临界值了。
还剩最后的两连高速弯，要减速才行。
可一旦减速，就挡不住企业了。
她也会减速的……我们是同时换的胎。
不——她可是企业，她一定会加速入弯的，赌自己能控制住。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 这是她最后的机会了，要么夺冠，要么冲出赛道！
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 前方，就是最后两个连续的高速弯。
而企业显然也意识到了同样的事，她的赛车没有任何退让的意思，依然紧紧压在我旁边。
指挥官正在和企业并驾齐驱，两个人的速度都快得惊人，丝毫没有任何减速的迹象。
这是在为夺得冠军做最后的争夺！
就在要冲出赛道的临界点，我和企业同时踩下刹车。
又几乎同时，在还没有完全回正方向的时候，提前补上了油门。
一瞬间，我甚至能清楚感觉到，如果再多半分，赛车就会直接被甩出赛道。
双方都没有退缩！指挥官和企业驾驶着近乎失控的赛车完美过弯！
赛车没有冲出去！
他们并排冲上终点前的直道。
并排冲线！
差距小到几乎看不清！！！
看台上的欢呼声像海浪一样席卷而来。
大屏幕上，最终成绩定格。
冠军是{car2026}车队。
让我们用最热烈的欢呼声音，喊出——指挥官～是～冠军！
嘀——确定夺冠，胜利庆祝礼解锁！
主看台旁，那座沉寂了整场比赛的巨型球体馆突然亮起。
接管完成。Error十三世，舞台交给你了。
下一秒，球体馆的外墙被一个巨大的像素猫猫头占据。
Error十三世头顶冒出一串金色气泡，每一个气泡里都放着一位车队成员的名字
{playername}、埃塞克斯、本宁顿、哈里森、约翰·罗杰斯、柯莱特、Error十三世……
{car2026}车队，我们是冠军！
我就知道你会赢的。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 赢啦！我们是冠军！
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 指挥官做得太棒啦！！
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 柯莱特……这是你做的？
嗯，这种时候，总不能让它只在仪表盘上庆祝吧？
当然，这可是我们大家的冠军！
颁奖台上，奖杯在灯光下泛着耀眼的光。
我和埃塞克斯一起伸出手，和车队的大家共同将它举起。
看台上的欢呼再次响起，仿佛整座城市都在为冠军喝彩。
让我们把最热烈的掌声、最响亮的欢呼，送给今天的冠军车队——
Hello Everybody——！欢迎各位收看本次“落日大道6小时耐力赛”的赛前特别节目♪
我是今天的特邀主持嘉宾，关岛！
而我身边的这位就是特邀记者——阿尔弗雷多~
各位观众大家好！
接下来就由我和阿尔弗雷多一起，为大家介绍本次参赛车队的最新情报！
【弹幕】前排前排！
【弹幕】终于开始了，急急急——
【弹幕】坐等爆料.jpg
【弹幕】快点快点~！
【弹幕】瓜子饮料有需要的吗?
我已经感受到大家的热情了！让我看看……哦~今天的第一个爆料就相当惊人呢！
演播屏上，第一支车队的资料伴随着光影特效弹了出来，
首先介绍的是夺冠热门选手之一——瑞鹤！
没错！作为车队的核心车手，瑞鹤拥有极高驾驶天赋和精准的走线能力，在弯道中的车身控制堪称一绝！
诶~这么说来，瑞鹤选手在驾驶技巧上几乎无可挑剔？
基本上说，瑞鹤选手在弯道速度和线路选择上是世界顶尖水准的。
如果能抓住对手的弱点，她完全有机会冲击冠军！
原来如此！那我们来看看她的对手——企业！
【弹幕】前方高能
【弹幕】名场面预定！
【弹幕】正六边形？
嗯？哦……没有弱点！毕竟是世界第一嘛~
咳咳……但是！
但是比赛瞬息万变，不到最后一刻，谁也不知道会发生什么！对吧！
【弹幕】找补得好努力
【弹幕】不愧是企业前辈
【弹幕】希望瑞鹤没在看直播……
【弹幕】那可真是让人在意呢~
没错！正如阿尔弗雷多所说，没到最后一刻谁也不知道结果！
我们一起来看下最后一则情报……咦，本届赛事的“公开体验组”里出现了一支非常有实力的车队！
【弹幕】还有高手？！
【弹幕】公开体验组？认真的？
【弹幕】会是亲爱的吗？一定是的对吧对吧！
【弹幕】欸欸欸~真的会有惊喜吗？
【弹幕】不论是谁，都希望大家能尽情享受比赛呢~
哼哼，我看弹幕上已经有人猜到了哦~
虽然我还没有掌握这支车队的完整信息，但下一期，下期一定给大家揭晓完整答案！
嗯嗯，大家想知道后续的话，就请持续关注我们的赛事特别直播节目！
各位，记得点关注不迷路哦~我们下次见！
【弹幕】哪来的谜语人

【弹幕】热乎乎的期待感停不下来♡~
赛事准备区里，布里斯托尔正对着一份物资清单来回核对。她的眉头越皱越紧，最后啪地合上了文件夹。
不见了。
scripts.actorName: 布里斯托尔 [“头”号调查员]

scripts.say: 旁边正在给各种物资箱子贴标签的威廉·D·波特凑了过来。
什么不见了？
一整箱1.2吨的赛事联名巧克力棒全不见了，原本就该放在这里的。
scripts.actorName: 布里斯托尔 [“头”号调查员]

scripts.say: 是不是搬到别的地方去了？
不可能。我核对了三遍，别的地方没有这批物资的签收记录。
scripts.actorName: 布里斯托尔 [“头”号调查员]

scripts.say: 布里斯托尔抬起头，突然变得兴奋起来。
这不是普通的物资短缺事件。这是——「巧克力棒大劫案」！
scripts.actorName: 布里斯托尔 [“头”号调查员]

scripts.say: 不不不，大劫案也太夸张了啦！可能只是有人拿错了——
无论如何还是先展开调查吧，我们去打听下情况。
scripts.actorName: 布里斯托尔 [“头”号调查员]

scripts.say: 两人快步穿过围场通道来到门口，维克斯堡正在拍摄宣传照。
维克斯堡小姐，你刚才有看到什么大型车辆出去吗？
scripts.actorName: 布里斯托尔 [“头”号调查员]

scripts.say: 唔……大型车辆么？好像只有一辆货车往那边去了~
车厢上还刷着赛事官方的标志呢。
我记得赛事官方今天没有运输需求吧……难道那就是嫌疑车辆？
很有可能！而且别的地方用不到这么多巧克力棒……这一定是一起有预谋的大劫案！
scripts.actorName: 布里斯托尔 [“头”号调查员]

scripts.say: 那就赶紧追上去吧！
威廉·D·波特翻身跨上停在旁边的Happy D，引擎发出一声清脆的轰鸣。
Happy D超音速冲刺，启动——！
话音未落，一道影子已经卷着气流冲出了围场，朝着滨海公路的方向疾驰而去。
滨海公路上，威廉压低身子紧贴着Happy D，追上了前方那辆刷着赛事标志的货车。
停、停车！前面的货车，立刻靠边停下！
货车缓缓减速，稳稳停靠在路边。驾驶座的车窗摇了下，樫野探出头来。
欸？！巧克力棒大盗是……樫野小姐？！
巧克力棒大盗？但是……
我运的不是赛车零件么？箱子上的标签是这样写的……
标签……？
她的视线扫过货厢里装着巧克力棒的箱子，上面的标签确实写着“赛车零件”。
笔迹歪歪扭扭的，还带着一个画得很得意的笑脸。
嗯？
标签是我昨天贴的……是我把“巧克力棒”和“赛车零件”贴反了……
空气安静了两秒，樫野眨了眨眼。
原来是这样哦~难怪一路上总觉得车子里香香的~
赛场整备室，就在众人整理器材时，本宁顿推着一块盖着幕布的白板，风风火火地冲了进来。
只见她把白板往众人面前一摆，随后猛地一掀幕布——
各位，车队宣传也是车队建设的一环，只有人气高了，才更容易吸引顶级赞助商！
而获取高人气的秘诀，就是——Cool！
所以我们现在急需一支超——酷的宣传片！
唔……没意见……
等、等一下！宣传片这种东西……要怎么拍啊？
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 这个嘛，拍摄、剪辑、包装、发布，全部交给我就好！
而且严格来说——现在已经在拍了哦♪
“超温柔可靠的万能后勤”——哈里森！
“超元气可爱的车队经理”——罗杰斯！
“超人气的王牌车手”——指挥官！
以及“专业的工程师”——柯莱特！
整备室的大家，突然陷入了一阵长久的沉默。
前面几个我姑且不说什么……为什么到柯莱特这里，突然风格就变了？
这你就不懂了吧！
反差，才能让人印象深刻！神秘，才能激发观众的好奇心！
再说了，柯莱特也没有意见对吧？
唔……没意见……
那个……我只负责后勤部分可以吗？如果要我正式出镜的话，我实在没什么自信……
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: Don’t worry~这点小问题我早就考虑到了！
大家只要像平时那样行动就行，剩下的全都交给我！
可平时……平时……我平时是怎么做的啊？！
scripts.actorName: 约翰·罗杰斯 [赛车女郎休憩中]

scripts.say: 我、我来检查下还缺什么东西！
scripts.actorName: 哈里森 [提前开始的追逐赛？]

scripts.say: 那我继续投喂电子宠物了……拍好了叫我。
很好很好，就是这样——3、2、1！Recording now!
指挥官，你也在练车吗？真巧呢~
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 刚刚结束一轮驾驶训练的我正打算找个地方休息，就被赛道旁的不挠叫住了。
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 她在车边轻晃着手中的冰镇饮料，衣服上还带着训练后尚未散去的余热。
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 我也才刚结束这场……“高强度”的训练呢……
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 呼……我们都辛苦了呀~
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 她抬起手，慢吞吞地喝了一小口饮料，带着满足意味的吞咽声从喉间溢出。
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 回想起她刚才在赛道上的速度……与其说是在进行赛车训练，倒更像是在悠闲兜风。
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 练习效果怎么样？
唔~马马虎虎吧~
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 不过，我可是有很认真地在练习走线哦~只是速度稍微保守了一点点……
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 只有“一点点”？
指挥官，这种时候就不要拆穿我了嘛……
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 光是维持刚才那样的速度，我都已经全身发软了。
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 她轻轻叹了口气，像是真的有些撑不住似的，顺势朝我这边倚了过来。
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 隔着贴身的赛车服，训练后的热意清晰地贴上了手臂。
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 要是再快一点的话……我的身体，肯定会融化吧？
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 更不用说，还得用那么快的速度去过弯……只是想一想，就会有些害怕呢……
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 她说着，又往我这边靠近了些，温热的气息时不时拂过颈侧，带起一阵轻微的痒意。
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 那要不要我陪你跑几圈？有人在旁边可能就不会害怕了。
嗯？哦~我懂你意思了哦，指挥官……
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 在我变得软绵绵的时候，确实必须有你陪在身边在行呢……
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 不挠握住了我的手，引导着我坐到了主驾上。
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 我们的身体自然地贴近，能感受到那贴在她肌肤上的润滑汗水。
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 下一秒，不挠便真的软了下来，整个人倚进我的怀里，轻得像一团柔软的云。
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 唔……我也很想立刻开始练习……
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 只是刚才那一圈，就已经把我的体力全都耗光了……
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 现在脑袋里嗡嗡的，连视线都有点发飘……根本没办法好好集中精神……
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 她说话时，冰饮残留下的清甜果香，混着她身上尚未散去的暖意缓缓弥漫开来。
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 所以在正式开始之前……必须先休息一下才行。
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 她抬起手，指尖轻轻搭上我的手臂，把身体更深地埋进了怀中。
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 别担心……不会让指挥官等太久的……
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 在那之前，就先让我像这样……稍微靠着你一会儿吧？
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 毕竟……指挥官的怀抱，可比赛车座椅舒服多了呢~
scripts.actorName: 不挠 [慵懒的领航员小姐]

scripts.say: 比赛开始前，埃塞克斯驾驶着赛车稳稳停在车检区，准备接受技术检查。
巴尔的摩戴着白手套，逐一检查着赛车的各项数据。
车身结构完整……悬挂系统、制动系统无异常。
她直起身，绕着赛车走了一圈，最后拉开驾驶座车门，探身检查座舱。
……这什么东西？
仪表盘的液晶屏幕右侧，一个像素风格的猫球正在滚来滚去。
那是我的电子宠物……名字叫Error十三世，很可爱吧？
不不不，现在不是谈论可不可爱的时候。
仪表盘上不能出现非功能性的视觉元素，这是规定。
那——有功能就可以了吧？
柯莱特掏出平板，手指在上面飞快地敲击。
不一会，屏幕上的猫球抖了抖，从屏幕外拖入一个气泡框，上面写着：胎压2.3bar。
已加入胎压监测功能。
那……我再加点？
柯莱特又是一阵密集的敲击。
屏幕上，显示着各种数据的气泡框接连砸下，Error十三世在气泡中艰难地左躲右闪——
直到被一块写着“水温98°C”的气泡框砸中脑袋，啪地一下，被可怜地压在了地上。
怎么样……这下该行了吧？
噗……咳咳。不，不好意思，虽然我很想说可以……但我是受过专业训练的。
只是把数据展示出来，有没有这电子宠物都一样，对吧？
欸……怎么这样……
柯莱特，把信息框都收回去，让Error十三世只在数据异常时提醒就好。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 对哦——我明白了。
柯莱特眼睛一亮，手指又动了起来。
屏幕上的Error十三世爬起来，张大嘴巴，将满屏的气泡框一口一口吞进肚子里，最后打了个饱嗝。
检查完毕，数据无异常，比赛加油~加油~
噗……好吧。这小家伙确实可爱，这次算你们通过了。
呼……终于……
辛苦了。
scripts.actorName: 埃塞克斯 [水漾在疾驰之前]

scripts.say: 咳，{car2026}车队全部项目通过，我去其他车队了。
巴尔的摩合上检查单，转身离开时肩膀还在微微发抖。柯莱特缓了口气，伸手戳了戳屏幕。
检查通过！赛事顺利！
傍晚，我来到了海岸边准备散散步，碰巧遇到了看起来很眼熟的银灰色跑车。
车门划开，鲁梅一只手搭在方向盘上，侧过头来看我，唇角噙着从容的笑。
我就知道你会出现在这里。怎么，还在为车队的事发愁吗？
她抬手理了理被风拂乱的发丝，丝绸般的衣料贴合着身体曲线，在傍晚的光线下泛着奢华的光。
嗯……？你的视线，似乎是对我这身衣服感兴趣？
嗯，特别定制的款式。难得有合心意又合季节的设计，就穿来给你看看。
很适合你。
呵呵，多谢夸奖。好了，上车吧。刚好我还有重要的事要和你谈谈。
应她的邀请，我走去另一侧拉开车门坐下，车内弥漫着冷调香水混合海风的气息。
{car2026}车队想走远，光靠实力不够。车队整体的概念包装和形象推广都很重要。
和一位深谋远虑的投资人合作，会对你们的未来计划很有帮助。
她侧过身，手臂搭在方向盘上，目光沉静。
所以，你愿意做这个投资人？
当然。我从不做没有把握的事，而我对你的车队——或者说，对你——很有把握。
她顿了顿，忽然凑近了一些，仔细端详着我的脸。
不过……指挥官，你果然有点紧绷吧？
有么？
有。所以今天我来找你，不只是谈合作。
她收回身，从后座拿出一个文件夹，但没有马上递过来，而是先放在了一边。
我还想帮你放松一下。
……帮我放松？
嗯，指挥官不用什么事都自己扛的，偶尔也该让别人照顾照顾你的。
她说着，伸出手，指尖轻轻碰了碰我的眉心，像是在把那道看不见的皱纹抹平。
你看，这样就好多了。
我伸手握住了她还没来得及收回的手，微凉的指尖在被我握住的瞬间轻轻颤了一下。
……指挥官？
我没有回答，倾身靠近的同时，将另一只手抬起，用指腹贴上她的脸颊。
指挥官……你用这种表情看着我，实在是……
你不是要帮我放松么？
……我、我是说让你放松，不是让你……
我吻了上去，落在她唇角，很轻。
她的唇瓣微微抿着，在我碰触的瞬间颤抖了一下，随后慢慢舒缓开来，整个人也软倒在我怀里。
指挥官……你突然……做什么？
不喜欢？
我……只是有点不习惯。
她别过脸去看车窗外，但手却从裙摆上松开，嘴角却不自觉地微微弯起。
但这种感觉……好像也不坏。
维修区的焦灼气氛被远远甩在身后，车载音响里流淌出的轻快鼓点成为了此刻唯一的主旋律。
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 本宁顿将车停在海滩边。这里只有我们两人，以及一望无际的夏日之海。
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 不是说要做赛前准备么……来海边做什么？
哈哈~指挥官，真正的赛前准备，是要把“心情”也调试到最放松的频道哦~
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 一直重复练习的话，比赛还没开始，你就要先把自己开报废了~
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 不如让海风还有音乐，以及独属于我们两人的时间，把你的心彻底放空——
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 这才是我的独家企划~
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 本宁顿随手解开安全带，伸了个懒腰。
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 阳光毫无保留地照在她的脖颈和锁骨上，为肌肤镀上了一层诱人的蜜色光泽。
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 享受完阳光的恩泽后，她将墨镜随意扔到后座。那双总是追逐着精彩瞬间的眼眸，此刻只倒映着我的身影。
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 嗯——Perfect！
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 阳光、海风、音乐，还有指挥官——all perfect！
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 所以……把我骗出来放松，其实还是为了拍素材？
捕捉最完美的阳光、风景、还有你毫无防备的笑容……
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 这些，全都是只属于我的珍贵素材哦~
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 被比基尼包裹的胸口随她说话轻缓起伏，阳光将系带下的肌肤晒出了一道浅浅的白印。
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 她踢掉脚上的高跟鞋，转过身，将那双光裸修长的腿直接搭上了我的膝头。
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 呼——像这样松弛地靠着，可比坐在驾驶座上舒服多了~
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 来吧，指挥官~你也来一起体验一下吧？
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: ……体验什么？
她笑着朝我勾了勾手指，等我下意识前倾时，她却忽然一把攥住我的衣领，将我整个人拉了过去。
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 我撑着座椅俯身压在她身上，凌乱的长发铺散在她身下，肩头细细的系带也顺着动作滑落了一截。
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 这样的行为……算是超速了吧？
在我们的双人企划里，限速标从来只是装饰而已~
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 她松开我的衣领，手掌贴着我的胸口缓缓下滑，停在了我的心口。
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 掌心下，我的心跳正毫不争气地加速着。
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 指挥官的心跳都快成这样了……
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 真的还打算嘴硬，说自己不想踩下这一脚油门吗？
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 她的手缓缓滑进我的掌心，指尖穿过指缝，一点点扣紧。
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 太阳还未落下，今天的赛程……还远远没到终点~
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 来吧，我的首席领航员——
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 接下来，你想带我开得更快一点……
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 还是说，要和我一起，试试那条谁都没走过的新路线♪
scripts.actorName: 本宁顿 [全速！盛夏逐光企划]

scripts.say: 比赛中段，轮换下场。我推开休息室的门，里面只亮着一盏暖黄的小台灯。
指挥官，比赛辛苦了。
嘿嘿，我们一直在等指挥官回来——你看你看！
scripts.actorName: 休斯敦II [新晋女仆已就绪]

scripts.say: 两人戴着兔耳装饰，面前的茶几上摆满了补给品：能量棒、香蕉、电解质水，还有一盒巧克力棒。
下一棒还要跑好久，指挥官要好好补充能量才行。
嗯嗯，这是专门给指挥官配的能量补充套餐——想先吃哪个？
scripts.actorName: 休斯敦II [新晋女仆已就绪]

scripts.say: 准备得这么周全？
拉菲查了耐力赛车手补给指南……休斯敦帮忙选的。
能量棒能快速恢复体力，电解质水补充流失的水分——啊，还有这个！
scripts.actorName: 休斯敦II [新晋女仆已就绪]

scripts.say: 她抽出一根巧克力棒，放在我的嘴边。
比赛后半程，糖分就是战斗力！
scripts.actorName: 休斯敦II [新晋女仆已就绪]

scripts.say: 拉菲也准备了。指挥官，请用。
拉菲也递过来一根。两人一左一右坐到我身边，各自举起自己那根巧克力棒。
指挥官，张嘴——啊——
咔嚓——巧克力棒的甜味在舌尖散开，和着里面酥脆的饼干，恰到好处。
太好了！那接下来是……
scripts.actorName: 休斯敦II [新晋女仆已就绪]

scripts.say: 拉菲也想吃……和指挥官一起吃……
拉菲揉了揉眼睛，从点心盒里抽出一根巧克力棒，叼在嘴里。
欸？指挥官，那个……我、我也想？
scripts.actorName: 休斯敦II [新晋女仆已就绪]

scripts.say: 休斯顿也学着抽出一根巧克力棒含在嘴里，脸颊已经红到了耳根，说话也含含糊糊的。
这样……能量补充得更快。
对、对！大家一起吃，恢复效果翻倍！……
scripts.actorName: 休斯敦II [新晋女仆已就绪]

scripts.say: 指挥官，请~
两根巧克力棒，一头是甜，另一头是什么——我还没咬下去，就已经知道了答案。
我拖着脚步走回维修区，想找个没人的角落缓一口气。
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 然后我在车库转角处，撞见了一个不该出现在这里的人。
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 维克斯堡？
啊，找到指挥官啦！
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 维克斯堡穿着一身亮闪闪的偶像活动服，正踮着脚尖往一个临时搭起的小台子上蹦。
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 嘘——！指挥官小声一点！
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 我拒绝了今天的所有邀请，偷偷溜进来找你，不能引起大家注意哦~
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 见四下并没有别人注意这里，她松了口气，拍了拍胸口，然后重新看向我。
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 那双眼睛亮晶晶的，映在其中的我也像是被众星包围着，分外耀眼。
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 指挥官比赛的样子太帅了~我在主持台上根本坐不住。
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 不过，这几天比赛强度这么大，指挥官一定累了吧？
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 接下来的演出是专门为你准备的~准备好了嘛，要开始了！
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 你这是要……？
当然是给你加油啦~指挥官每一次努力，我都看在眼里哦！
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 所以我就想——至少要来面对面给指挥官加油才行！
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 她握紧放在一旁的旗帜，踮起脚尖蹦上旁边那个用来做赛事采访的小台子，像是在给自己打气般深吸一口气。
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 维克斯堡，闪亮登场——呀！一不小心就进入舞台模式了！
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 她吐了吐舌头，脸上浮起一层薄薄的红晕。
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 那、那个……指挥官，可以麻烦你帮我打一下节拍吗？不用太复杂，就一下一下的就好……
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 好。
我轻轻拍起手，一下，两下，三下——她的双手也随着节拍在胸口比成心形。
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 爱心~
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 又三个节拍，她展臂，抬腿，旗帜在她的手中挥出一个闪亮的半圆。
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 闪耀~
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 然后手臂在空中划出弧线，最后收在胸口。她歪着头看我，眼睛亮晶晶的。
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: Lucky Power~♪
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 怎么样怎么样？指挥官，刚才的pose，有感受到幸运能量的注入吗？
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 很可爱，感受到了。还可以许愿更多么？
当然可以啦！我今天可是——等等，指挥官刚刚说“可爱”了？
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 红晕从脸颊一直蔓延到耳根，带着少女特有的羞涩与认真。
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 那……那再看一个！
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 她微微侧身，单手举旗过头顶，另一只手轻轻搭在胸前……
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 她全神贯注地变换着姿势，完全没注意到脚边的一颗小石子。一个旋转动作幅度大了些——
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 呜啊——！
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 她失去平衡的瞬间我已经冲了出去，搂住她的腰肩，稳稳抱在怀里。
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 没事吧？
呼……谢谢指挥官。一不小心就出现舞台事故了……
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 你没事就好。
我确认她站稳了，想松开手，却感觉衣角被轻轻攥住了。
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: ……再一会。就这样，保持一会儿，可以吗？
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 她尚未平复的呼吸轻轻吹拂着我，一点一点将我肩上的重担卸下。
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 指挥官的怀抱，好温暖~
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 明明是来给指挥官加油的……结果反而是我被治愈了呢~
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 她抬起头，白皙的脸颊上浮着两团因为舞蹈和紧张而蒸出的绯红，嘴唇轻轻抿了一下，像是下定了什么决心。
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 指挥官，接下来——请接受我的祝福吧~
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 这样，就可以一起舒服起来哦……♡
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 她慢慢地合上眼，果冻般唇瓣在日光下轻轻翘起。
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 我低下头，时间好像暂停了很久很久，等我们分开时，她的脸上带着诱人的红晕。
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: ……怎么样？指挥官现在，应该精神满满了吧~！
scripts.actorName: 维克斯堡 [闪亮的赛车偶像]

scripts.say: 庆祝的喧嚣尚未完全散去，我独自回到了车库，看见了倚墙而立的武藏。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 正想开口，她却像是察觉到我的靠近一般，缓缓抬头，对我露出一抹意味深长的笑。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 呵呵……终于肯来见你的专属应援者了吗，我的冠军？
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

options.content: 我以为你已经先回去了。

scripts.say: 此刻的她，穿着与平日威仪截然不同的应援装束，在舞台的灯光下泛着晶莹的光泽。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 我以为你已经先回去了。
怎么会呢？今夜的主角尚未尽兴，我又怎会独自离场。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 只是稍稍花了些时间，想让自己从赛场的余韵中平复下来。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 这身打扮很适合你。
……呵呵，这样的夸奖，对现在的我而言倒是有些狡猾呢~
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 那么，指挥官……不，我的冠军。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 今夜，就让我来为你点亮——这独属于你的冠军时刻吧。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 花球在她的手中灵巧地翻飞，带起细微的风声。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 每一次转身，每一次回眸，那身装束都恰到好处地勾勒出她丰满流畅的身体线条。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 一套应援动作结束，她仿佛真的将今夜所有的喝彩都收束于掌心，再毫无保留地献给我一人。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 呵呵……看来，比起言语，身体的语言果然更有效呢~
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 今夜，我将把所有喝彩、所有热情，都毫无保留地献给你了。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 那么现在，好好享受这份只属于你的荣耀吧~
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 她轻轻一笑，松开指间的花球，任它滚落到脚边。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 下一刻，那双修长双腿便向前逼近一步，将原本就不多的距离彻底吞没。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 我还未来得及开口，她便已抬起手，将我拢进怀中。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 柔软的触感隔着衣料缓缓贴近，连同她尚未散去的体温一起，将夜晚的凉意尽数驱散。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 今晚你已经赢下了最耀眼的胜利。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 接下来，就不必再费心说什么了。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 你只要站在这里，接受我为冠军准备的奖赏……就够了。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 她握住我的手腕，引着我的手贴上她的大腿。瞬间，滑腻的触感印入掌心，带着她运动后尚未散去的温热。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 就这样被她引导着，缓慢地、一寸一寸地上移。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 今夜……所有灯光，所有掌声，所有荣耀，都属于你。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 而我……也不例外——
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 她俯下身，嘴唇衔住我的耳廓，温热的吐息随之灌入耳中。
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 来吧，我的冠军……
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

scripts.say: 就让我一点一点……将你所有的疲惫，都温柔地卸下吧♡
scripts.actorName: 武藏 [只为你献上的应援]

sequence: Scorching Summer Wavechasers  1 Summer Breeze, Cameras, and Engines

scripts.say: The sunset glow bathes the grandstands, the decorations and flags strung above high, and the entire circuit.
I came here at Bennington's invitation, but the Sunset Avenue 6-Hour Endurance Rally pre-event had already begun some time ago.
Hi, Commander! Welcome back to my channel! Lovely to see you!
I hear a very familiar greeting behind me, but before I even have time to say anything, she grabs me by the hand and drags me to the center of the venue.
Wait, hold it!
We're already late! The pre-event started, like, ages ago!
If we don't move fast, I'm not gonna be able to get enough good footage to make content!
Bennington walks backwards as she takes pictures of everything, expertly pulling me along as we go through the entrance.
Time for the special event coverage! Ready for the summer race lead-up segment! And... we're filming!
We're all here, the location's set up, the sunset's just right, the sea breeze is breezing by... Yep, all perfect!
If I can hype up the opening well, all the videos about the event will have tons of views! That's just how it works, Commander~
As the lights illuminating the venue change in time with the music's beat, the place's already buzzing with excitement.
Basking in the lights, the guest MC, Vicksburg, notices our arrival and cheerfully waves the flag in her hand towards us.
Heart twinkle winkle! Lucky power♪
With a powerful drum beat and the cheers of the crowd, Vicksburg makes the whole venue vibrate with anticipation.
Whoa, the vibe's just the best!
The sea breeze, the sunset, the music, and the cheers... Now this is what summer is all about!
Did you come to watch the event, or film it?
Why not both?
Documenting everything and taking the time to enjoy myself... That's what my streamer sense is telling me♪
What's good, everyone? Welcome to the Sunset Avenue 6-Hour Endurance Rally pre-event!
The stage's lighting shifts from bright and warm to a simple white light, and the large screen in the center stage switches to an overhead view of the circuit and the rally logo.
With brisk steps, Vicksburg moves onto the main stage and waves cheerfully at the audience.
Before I introduce our circuit, I have a big surprise for you all!
In order to help as many people as possible enjoy the event, we've prepared a special public experience team!
If you submit the initial entry today, then finish the car check and driver registration after that...
You'll drive and feel the wind rushing through your hair as you grip the wheel! Pitting yourself against drivers who can give professionals a run for their money! At max speed!
Why, maybe you could be the one to rise to the top and raise the trophy?
If you feel the speed calling you right now, don't wait! Gather your courage and get started while there's still time!
It's so cool. You love racing cars, don't you, Rodgers? You're participating for sure, yes?
Huh? I just came along to accompany you! Don't blow it out of proportion, please!
The air is positively crackling with excitement, and it rubs off onto Bennington in no time.
Hey, hey, Commander! Did you hear? Isn't this, like, a crazy opportunity?
Don't you wanna participate too?
While I ponder, the sisters Harrison and Rodgers approach us.
Hm? Commander?
Ah, how lovely to see you! And Bennington too!
Are you entering the race too?
Don't make it sound like WE'RE entering! I have not agreed to any of this! Not even once!
Besides, how could we put a team together when we can't even drive a car?
As soon as Bennington hears that, she turns her camera to focus on our conversation.
Commander, you know your way around a car, don't you?
Just a bit. But I'm just here sightseeing... You know, enjoying my vacation and all that...
Oh, come on! It'd be an uber-waste to let a super race like this just pass you by! Literally!
Hearing that, John Rodgers seems to make up her mind, and she comes over right away.
Commander, I'll have you know...
And just so we're clear, I'm not saying this because the cheering has me hyped or anything!
I... I thought about it really hard, and thought it might... it just might be worth it to give it a try.
Heheh, allow me to help as well!
Ahem... Anyway, that's about it.

options.content: It seems a bit sudden, but...

scripts.say: Y-you're free to decline if you want. I was just curious, no pressure or anything...
Sounds like fun.
It seems a bit sudden, but...
Okay, let's get in this race!
What?! Just like that?!
Oh yeah!
Nice! That's the summer spirit! Nothing screams summer like a last-minute challenger! Now this is content!
But your team will need a name! Commander, say the name loud and clear for the camera!
How does {car2026} sound?
Hm, I can live with that.
What a wonderful name, Commander!
Okay, that's settled, then! {car2026} is off to the races! I can't wait to see it high on that scoreboard!

EN.title: Trouble? Pit Team to the Rescue!

sequence: Scorching Summer Wavechasers  2 Trouble? Pit Team to the Rescue!

scripts.say: Hi there! Welcome to my sweet new project! I'm calling it the Commander's Summer Race Project!
Bennington, we're not in the race course just yet. Can you tone down the intensity just a little?
While pulling off an unnecessarily flashy drift, Bennington slides a car into our temporarily assigned pit.
Commander! Over here!
I spot John Rodgers and Harrison carrying in supplies like drinks, toolboxes, boards, and various miscellaneous items.
Suddenly, I can't shake the feeling that I might just be surrounded by pros.
We've been waiting~
If we're really participating, I figured we should get everything we might need stocked up.
Yep, yep! The backup system is working like a dream!
I declare the {car2026} logistical support plan officially launched! Yay!
You don't need to hype up literally everything we do!
Or so she says, but it's clear the acknowledgment is giving her confidence.
We got all the paperwork ready.
The initial entry, the car check, and the driver registration... If we can complete all those before the qualifiers, we'll be an official team.
You're really pumped for this, huh?
O-of course! We're already here, so we can't go having people think we're just messing around without a plan!
As we go over the entry form that Rodgers brought, I'm immediately confronted with the first big roadblock.
Oh? The car registration is still blank.
Um... Car?
Well... It was a little outside our scope, so...
Rodgers throws an uneasy glance at the car parked in our pit lane. Currently, it's being occupied by Bennington's car.
Hmmm? What are you looking at? Oh, I'm such a klutz. I went and put my girl in your pit!
Wait... Were you planning for this the whole time?
Bingo! I knew we'd be here when you got all fired up yesterday~
My little girl's been modified for racing, so we can make this rally her debut! No biggie!
This is not quite what I had in mind... But we can enter the race, at least!
Commander, do you wanna take it for a trial run?
Mhm, great idea. We need to measure the car's performance and get familiar with the course. And it'll also let us make any adjustments we need before the real deal♪
Okay, let's go for one lap.
And so, {car2026} gets off to an auspicious start after a spot of trouble.

EN.title: A Helping Hand for the Rookie Team

sequence: Scorching Summer Wavechasers  3 A Helping Hand for the Rookie Team

scripts.say: For the first lap of the trial run, I keep a steady pace instead of pushing the engine to get used to the racetrack and see how the vehicle handles.
Once the run is completed, I realize the car's tuning is not quite up to snuff, probably on account of being completely new.
That was a clean run! Good job, Commander. Go ahead and have a drink!
How was it? Think it'll work?
Hm, it works well enough, but the car felt a little stiff to handle.
I take a cold drink from her hands as I try to recall the feeling I got from the trial run. It's important to have some accurate feedback that we can use for tuning..
...Commander, you make it sound like you drove a tractor just now.
It's not that the car is bad, but it's not quite up for a real race just yet.
Hm, this might be more of a fixer-upper than we thought.
Not the kind of thing amateurs like us can deal with, though...
So what we need is someone who can identify the issues with our ride and adjust properly if we wanna participate?
Pretty much, yes. We need a real engineer.
Rodgers's expression sours as if something unpleasant crossed her mind.
Whoa, this is just like a movie! Let me guess, you know just the person for the job, don't you, Rodgers?!
...You pointing it out kind of deflates the moment, but I do know someone.
Really?! Oh, we're saved!
Okay, you gotta cool off! I don't know if it'll work out or not!
I just heard her talking about tuning and setting stuff up before... So I figured maybe she knows more about it than us! And that's a big maybe!!
Maybe?
A big maybe?
How big are we talking?
Yeah, that's why I didn't wanna say anything! I don't know if they're up for it!
Well, we're not exactly drowning in options, so why don't we go see if this someone might be able to help us for real?
Great idea. We might as well go find out ourselves.
When our brave team is about to throw in the towel... A helper appears to save the day! This is gonna be the best video series ever!
Can we not make it sound like this is all staged?!

sequence: Scorching Summer Wavechasers  4 Techie Jackpot

scripts.say: To all my new followers, good morning, afternoon, and evening to you!
Bennington swings the camera around, capturing the entrance of the paddock before focusing on John Rodgers as she walks in front of the group.
Like you saw previously, the trial run revealed a bunch of issues with the car, and now we're on a quest to find a super pro engineer!
Now Rodgers is leading us to the car wash... If the movies I've watched are anything to go by, that's a prime hiding spot for world class engineers!
Can you stop recording? I only said it seemed like she knew about tuning. I didn't say anything about world class engineers or whatever!
I mean, what else am I gonna tell my viewers?
We follow the line of cars waiting their turn to be washed, and quickly reach the race car at the front.

There we find a girl floating in the air, suspended in place by a large drone. Somehow, she seems to come out of her restful sleep to spray water on the cars with a nozzle hose she's holding, all without opening her eyes.
Collett? She can tune a car?
I-I said maybe... Big maybe...
She's just kind of, floating... Is she okay?
Might as well ask her.
I step forward and call out to her.
Collett? Wake up, please?
She doesn't react, however. Instead, the drone starts rotating until its camera lens settles on me.
I am Error XIII... Identifying visitors.
Maximum priority target identified: the Commander. Executing emergency awakening protocol.
The drone vibrates in place. After a moment, Collett raises her head and looks down at me, still looking quite groggy.
Mguh... Are we done with the car wash?
Took you long enough, sleepyhead.
Rodgers?
Collett's gaze shifts from Rodgers to me, then settles on the camera Bennington is holding.
...No interviews.
Aw, that's a shame. I wanted to do behind-the-scenes interviews!
...Did you come here just to bother me?
Ah, Collett. Do you know about tuning cars?
She seems to ponder for a moment before lazily shaking her head.
I've never tuned a real race car...
Huh? But you were using a bunch of technical jargon the other day.
I've been playing this simulation racing game a lot lately... And I got really into the tuning aspect, that's all.
Once it becomes clear that this was just one big misunderstanding, the mood turns awkward really fast.
But instead of turning back and going away with our tails between our legs, Collett's words give me an idea.
Well, you may not be able to do tuning, but how about analyzing what the vehicle might need based on feedback?
She doesn't seem to dislike the idea.
...I could do that.
If it's just tracking parameters based on feedback, course analysis, and tire condition... I could take care of it.
Does that mean that our beautiful race car still has a chance?
As long as it's not in a really bad condition.
If the car hasn't been too modified, data based adjustments should help most problems.
That sounds great to me.
Wanna join $2, Colette? We're looking for someone who can do data analysis and tuning.
Colette lets go of the hose, signals to her drone, and drops in front of us.
Sure. Just don't give me too much work that involves talking to people.
Deal. Thanks, and welcome to the team!
Heheh, this is finally starting to feel like a racing team~
Phew... This didn't go like I expected, but it worked out in the end, so I'm glad.
"$2 gains another powerful ally on its way to the top! A mysterious, eccentric genius engineer joins the fray!" I got the next video title ready!
Having gained a reliable new ally, we make our way back to the pit.

sequence: Scorching Summer Wavechasers  5 Pulling Her Back In

scripts.say: Hello! Great to see you all again! The Commander's summer race saga continues!
Bennington slides across the pit gracefully, pointing her camera at a corner of the room where Collett is curled up into a ball on top of a toolbox with a tablet in her hands.
Behold! Thanks to Collett, our car tuning is coming along swimmingly!
However... While the tuning machine warmed up, a new problem reared its ugly head!
A problem?
Yes! A six-hour endurance rally is not something a single driver can manage! You need a relief driver!
So we need a racer that can switch with the Commander?
We're gonna need a pro for this.
Heh, heh, heh! Well, it seems we're in luck! The perfect person for the job showed up just in time!
Bennington, who had clearly waited for this moment for maximum theatrical effect, quirks up a defiant smile.
Who are you talking about?
Heh! Heh! As it turns out, Essex is currently enjoying her vacation in a hotel nearby.
She's not participating?
Maybe she wanted to take a break like you? I'm sure she'd accept an invitation from you, though.
Well, it can't hurt to pay her a visit.
Let's go! The next video will be about the sea breeze, vacations, and racers!
Leaving the pit, I walk along the esplanade surrounding the venue until we come across a fancy seaside hotel.
As the evening sun sinks down on the horizon, I come across the hotel's outdoor pool, where I find Essex enjoying the water.
Commander?
Oh, Bennington was right about you being here.
I'm on vacation right now, you know? If you're here about work, well...
Oh, not at all. I'm on vacation too. Don't you wanna do something fun to make the most of it?
Make the most of it? W-what do you have in mind?
I'd like you to join our team. It's called {car2026}.
That sounds... Huh? Your team?
Seeing the surprise and confusion on her face, I explain the situation.
Essex listens closely, the gentle breeze passing by us as her expression hardens.
I think I get it now.
If you're really serious about gearing up for this race and competing, you'll need a capable racer who's able to make snap decisions and grasp the situation on the race track.
That's right. And I believe you're the last piece of the puzzle for us.
Essex studies me with her intense gaze, gauging how serious I am about this race.
...Very well.
I will join your team as a relay racer.
And now that I'm part of the team, "doing our best" alone won't cut it.
If we're racing, we need to set our expectations high and prepare for victory.
Pace plans, coordination, and dividing our driving roles... We'll execute a perfect plan to achieve victory.
Bring it on.
Heheh, I knew you'd see it my way.
She swims over closer, and I take her hand to pull her up to the poolside.
Let's go to the racetrack.
We're in this race, and I'll give it my all until we make it past the goal.
The sunset light plays about in the water behind her, giving her an almost otherworldly glow.
And so, {car2026} obtains its last crucial team member.

sequence: Scorching Summer Wavechasers  6 Pole Position Will Be Ours!

scripts.say: Little time remains until the qualifier race begins.
Thanks to the team's efforts, the car is finally in a stable state.
Suspension, brakes, tire turning radius... I've got all of the details memorized.
Anything else we need to adjust?
Yes. I've adjusted the differential to a more aggressive setup per my preferences. That should allow for earlier and bolder acceleration when pulling out of corners.
The trade-off is that rougher handling will cause greater wear on your tires.
So what you're saying is, I can drive more aggressively during the qualifier, but I'll have a narrower window to shoot for lap records.
That's right... You'll only be able to hold up for two laps, at best. Any more, and your tires are done for.
Hi there, everybody! Great work today!
Bennington comes in, greeting us as energetically as ever.
Here I am – famously stylish, reliable, and popular car owner, WITH legal visitation rights – to check on my ride!
Checking on it, huh? Yeah, right. You're obviously just here to shoot footage.
Call it killing two birds with one stone. Behind-the-scenes footage, pre-race chit-chat, and technical updates are all primo material!
Let's see here... What modifications have you all made to my baby?
She points her camera at the driver's seat. Just as she opens her mouth to speak her mind, however, she pauses.
Hmm...? Was this little thing there before?
Everybody looks at where she's pointing. There, on the dashboard, we see a tiny virtual pet made of pixels.
Hi there!
BEEP! Voice activation detected.
Error XIII is now booting up.
Wait, what even is that?
Awww! It's so cuuute!
That's my digital pet. Consider it a support module with a visual interface.
It assists in monitoring vehicle status, sets off alerts when certain preset values are reached, and also has simple voice reminders...
Should you be installing things like that in a race car?!
Don't worry. I've checked the rules, and as long as it doesn't override control of the vehicle, it violates no regulations.
Heheh. I set up a big celebration for Error XIII, too... though it won't unlock unless you win.
It sounds like I'd better give it my all, then.
Too cool! I can't wait to film the team's victory declaration♪
Bennington excitedly raises her camera and records several videos of me and Error XIII together.
Alright! From now on, you're the mascot of Team {car2026}, little buddy.
BEEP! New identity confirmed. Receiving compliments.
Mood level boosted!
An announcement echoes outside the garage. It seems it's time for the final check-in for the qualifier race.
Tension that had been eased by this unexpected event suddenly returns to us.
Let's go.
Rodgers and I are standing by, ready to support at any time!
Data link functioning. Monitoring interface is A-OK, too.
BEEP! All systems on standby.
You're our first driver, Commander. Knock 'em dead!
For a team so hastily slapped together, {car2026} has come further than any of us have ever imagined. Now, we stand before the qualifying race.
All of the heart that we've poured into this effort will be tested in the upcoming race.
Here I go.
Pole position will be ours!

sequence: Scorching Summer Wavechasers  7 Let the Qualifier Begin!

scripts.say: Commentary overlaps with the roar of engines, adding fuel to the fiery anticipation around the circuit.
Cheers erupt from the grandstands of Sunset Avenue as lights, flags, and countless cameras turn toward the track.
Finally, the moment has come.
This is your host, Guam, speaking! The Sunset Avenue 6-Hour Endurance Rally's qualifier is about to begin!
Who will win the coveted pole position?
Will it be our seasoned racer, Enterprise?
Or Zuikaku, known for her aggressive driving?
Or perhaps even the dark horse of the event, the rookie driver... none other than the Commander!
Now, before the race begins, let's hear your loudest cheers for all of our drivers!
Above the track, the five starting lights all drop to green. We all put the pedal to the metal in perfect sync.
Can you hear me, Commander?
Loud and clear.
Data transmission and monitoring look good.
Since this is your first race, don't feel pressured to push for time right away. Warm up as planned and get your car and mind used to the track.
Got it.
I gently push the accelerator further, pushing the car close to its limits but not quite there, taking each corner smoothly.
The steering feedback, feeling of tires against the pavement, suspension bouncing over the curbs... All of the senses I'd cultivated over days of practice are renewed.
The wind is starting to shift.
There's a rare elation in Collett's voice, prompting me to focus up.
Wind speed rising. It's about 20 minutes earlier than expected.
The weather forecast had predicted that cloud cover and crosswinds wouldn't come for another half-hour.
Unexpected wind on a race track can swing variables wildly.
Commander, pay close attention to the airflow changes.
Roger that.
As the qualifier continues, everyone on the track picks up speed.
Fuel levels remain within expected levels, and the tires haven't quite hit their optimal temperature. However, the changes in the weather add to the excitement and tension.
Guess I'll have to push earlier than planned.
If I wait any longer, the wind will only get worse!
Whoa! The rankings are shifting like never before!
Enterprise just clocked a crazy-strong lap! Zuikaku is keeping up close behind, with Indomitable a steady third!
And our Commander is steadily closing in, too!
Today's qualifier might just be more intense than we'd imagined!

sequence: Scorching Summer Wavechasers  8 Wind-Racing Ace

scripts.say: The time ticks by.
Twenty minutes later, clouds hang low over the circuit. The road surface looks dark compared to its previous luster.
Zuikaku, the wind is getting violent. Don't get too reckless out there.
It's still just the qualifier, so keeping up your current pace will be enough.
Got it, Sis.
The wind speed only picks up further. Before high-speed corners, my car even begins to rock slightly.
Crosswinds are intensifying, especially in the second sector.
Compared to ten minutes ago, you'll need nearly 10% more steering correction when entering corners.
By this point, everybody should be playing it safe. Whether you want to set a lap record here depends on your own judgment rather than your car's abilities.
I cross the finish line, ending a lap and displaying a new fastest lap on the screen.
You've set a new lap record.
2:00.135! We have a new lap record for the Sunset Avenue Endurance Rally!
However, that time does not last long. It's quickly overcome by a faster time.
Another update!
1:59.977! That's Enterprise's ninth lap.
1:59.977! Enterprise has broken the two-minute barrier!
She's far and away the fastest now! Will anybody be able to catch up?!
I take a deep breath and ease my pace slightly.
It's a minuscule gap – less than a quarter of a second – but it stands as an impenetrable barrier to the rest of us.
Unfortunately, the wind conditions have made it impossible to push any further.
If I let my ego take the lead and run the car off the track, it will put all of our preparations so far to waste.
Fuel at 20%. Tire grip is at optimal levels.
Essex, how much time is left?
Ten minutes.
The wind is now blowing strong enough to exert clear effects on machine handling.
She's right. It would be beyond reckless to push for pole position at a time like this.
And yet... I can't give up now.
If there's a chance, however minuscule, then I have to try.
There's a brief silence on the team's comms channel. Eventually, Essex speaks.
Prioritize safety and manage your tire conditions. Collett will identify the ideal opportunity for you.
Got it. Thank you.
Meanwhile, somebody on another team's channel has figured out our scheme.
My honey really isn't scared of the wind, huh?
That's not it. The Commander is just waiting for one last chance to surpass my record.
Then why are you so calm?
Because I would do the same thing in the Commander's shoes.
More and more cars slow down on the track.
Holding onto position seems the prudent strategy, after all.
That's exactly why it surprises everybody when I continue to pick up speed.
What's this?
Not everybody has chosen to play it safe!
The Commander is accelerating!
In the final moments of the qualifier, when the wind is most unstable, the Commander is going for a flying lap!
Go ahead! Seize that pole position, Commander!
I stare at the straightaway ahead, listening in to the wind shrieking against the car.
The persistent tug of the wind suddenly eases for a moment. With the changing of the airflow, my moment of opportunity has arrived.
Now!
This lap is everything! Go, Commander!
I put the pedal to the metal – top gear, full throttle.
With the wind at my back, I push the car to its limit, rushing through every corner.
The Commander is advancing at top speed!
No, even faster now! Still accelerating, still closing the gap!
Entering the chicane... Whoa! The wind is causing turbulence!
Can the Commander keep the car pointed forward?
I instinctively counter-steer and punch it, managing to keep the turbulence to only a minor wiggle as the car exits the turn.
The car exits the corner! It's going for the finish line!
BEEP! Target achieved.
Spectacularly done, Commander!
I ease off the accelerator, letting the car coast as Essex congratulates me.
My heart is still pounding, and the tension of fighting the wind itself still stings my palms.
What a big W! That was a heart-pounding finale!
Just when everybody thought that the qualifier was set in stone, the Commander pulled off a huge turnaround at the very end!
Today, the pole position belongs to a real ace!

sequence: Scorching Summer Wavechasers  9 The Main Event Begins!

scripts.say: The members of {car2026} gather in the pit, making our final preparations for the six-hour rally.
Okay, we're about ready... Oh! The drivers' parade is starting soon. Are you good to go, Commander?
Yeah.
Since we'd secured the pole position during yesterday's qualifier, our car is given the pride of place.
Vicksburg makes a dazzling entrance! Welcome, everybody, to the Sunset Avenue 6-Hour Endurance Rally!
Yesterday's qualifier was a real show, but the true competition has yet to begin!
Now, let's introduce the drivers! Give them all a big round of applause so good fortune will follow them on the track!
Drivers are displayed one after another onscreen. Enterprise, Zuikaku, Indomitable... They're all formidable drivers.
The instant our team is displayed, the stands erupt with even louder cheers than before.
Commandeeer! Look! Over here!
You got this!
Whatever happens, I'll be waiting for you in the interview corner!
Wow! The audience has gotten really fired up!
It looks like everybody is eager to see if the Commander can keep up yesterday's incredible performance!
Amidst the cheering from the stands, the most formidable rivals cast glances toward us.
Honey! I couldn't take my eyes off your last lap yesterday!
But the qualifier and the main event are two different things.
You'll need more than just grit for a six-hour relay!
New Jersey...
Alright, I just wanted to give a friendly reminder~
Commander, that last lap was brilliant.
But today's race will test your rhythm, judgment, and endurance.
If you wanna win, it'll take more than just speed.
I know.
Zuikaku and Shoukaku approach.
I'm not losing to you again!
We'll give it our all, too.
Hehe. Let's do our best, Commander~
The parade ends, and we return our race cars to the starting positions for the formation lap.
As the lead car, I can take my time warming up the tires.
Comms normal.
Tire temperatures normal!
Wind speed steady.
Commander, conditions are ideal for your start.
As long as there are no unexpected problems, you can take a smooth first corner.
But remember, you shouldn't push as hard as you can on your first lap.
This isn't a sprint. Only those who can keep going until the very end can take victory.
Roger that.
It's Bennington on commentary again! The cars are just about to finish their formation lap!
Everybody ready for the Sunset Avenue 6-Hour Endurance Rally?
Five...
Four...
Three...
Two...
One...
Go, go, go! Let the race begin!
As the red lights turn off, the entire starting straight bursts into action with a roar as dozens of race cars rocket forth in unison.

sequence: Scorching Summer Wavechasers  10 The Pro Difference

scripts.say: The start goes smoothly, and now, I'm facing the first corner.
I hug the inside line and hit the brakes at the right time, perfectly hitting the clipping point.
The cars behind me start catching up. They're all vying for the optimal line, but I don't let go of my lead.
Look at that!
That's the first corner done and dusted!
Good going! Keep up your pace.
For the first few laps, the car maintains a consistent performance.
I put down my guard a little to avoid wearing down the tires too soon.
But now I'm realizing how different this is from the qualifiers.
How far do I push the car for one lap? How much should I take care of not wearing out the tires? What kind of pace should I aim for?
A firm sense of endurance and how to pace myself suddenly gain a lot more weight in this race's outcome.
Enterprise came up ahead!
She came out of that corner with great traction, and she took the lead in the long straight!
And Zuikaku follows close behind!
Aah, this is the real deal! Having the lead at the start doesn't mean it's easy to maintain!
Enterprise's movements show no hesitation and incredible precision. There's virtually no fat to cut in her maneuvering.
And Zuikaku is like a blade that doesn't miss a weakness to strike. She looks out for the moment your defense lowers and counters viciously.
And Indomitable follows along quietly instead of trying to force her way in, patiently waiting for an opportunity to seize.
In long endurance races like this, the more experienced runners will keep improving their lap times.
Commander, you should...
Keep my cool, right?
You know it.
But the situation does not improve.
I manage to defend my spot once, but I end up having to give way twice. My lack of experience makes itself apparent as the other drivers whiz ahead of me.
An hour and a half has passed since the race started! The situation for each team looks very different now!
Despite starting in the pole position, the Commander has been outdone by the more experienced racers!
The Commander has been forced to adopt a more passive strategy, trailing the leading group!
Our ranking on the big leaderboard shows we've dropped down to sixth place.
The initial illusion of victory was short lived, fading the longer the race continues.
But I manage to keep my composure.
Because I realize now that this is a race that can't be won with one person's power alone.

sequence: Scorching Summer Wavechasers  11 The Team's Fightback

scripts.say: I pull up to the pit and hand the car over to Essex.
Compared to me, her driving is more efficient and her pace more consistent.
Tires ready!
Pit out! Pit out! Pit out!
Understood!
The moment the car leaves the pit lane, I'm left watching the race from our side of the track.
{car2026} has switched drivers smoothly!
13.1 seconds is a super good time! And the next driver is Essex!
Can she use her trademark steady driving to change the tide of this race for {car2026}?
It doesn't take long for the answer to make itself clear.
Essex doesn't try any fancy maneuvers or techniques, instead choosing to trail the car ahead closely.
But once she's given even the slightest of chances, she mercilessly cuts the car on the inside and overtakes it.
Collett, what's the time for the car in front in sector 2? Their team hasn't pitted in a while, have they?
Her lap time is getting worse!
Okay, I'm not gonna make a move on the first corner.
I'll get my chance when her traction drops by the third corner!
Essex is sorta scary...
That's another overtake in the bag for Essex!
She's not being aggressive and wedging herself into every corner like you'd usually expect, but she's still closing the gap with each lap!
John Rodgers nods approvingly as she listens to Bennington's commentary.
Mhm, that's totally right.
Are you sure you get it?
Of course!
Look at how she routes around corners. She's a total veteran, right?
She is taking those really consistently.
And fast too.
Collett's tablet also confirms that her lap times are getting faster and faster.
Hmm, now this I wasn't expecting.
Enterprise, Essex is catching up to us really fast.
She's always known when to strike.
Let's widen the gap while we can.
By the time the rally enters its second half, the team is hot on the heels of the top spots thanks to Essex.
As our team climbs up the rankings in the large circuit screen, the mood in the paddock switches up.
We're catching up!
The top spots are Zuikaku and Enterprise... And Indomitable's managed to keep a consistent third up until now.
This is where the race gets good!
Essex is breaking into the top three! Now she's facing off against Indomitable!
Hm?! Did Indomitable just move aside to let her through?! Now Essex is going off to Zuikaku!
The gap is closing fast! This is a crucial battle for second place! And to decide who gets a shot at the top spot!
Essex doesn't go for the attack right away. Instead, she rides the slipstream and aims to make her move on the next straight.
Back for a fight, eh?! Well, I'm not letting you get ahead of me now!
Not when I haven't had a chance to get back at the grey ghost ahead...
Hmph! Bring it on!
Sensing Essex's intentions, Zuikaku matches her and goes full speed just before the next corner.
Both are pushing their speed to the limit! Whoa... Zuikaku is going even faster and keeping her lead!
Zuikaku's not giving an inch today! She's holding on to her lead!
Even with her tires worn out, she's keeping up strong!
But a loud bang echoes in the track as one of Zuikaku's tires burst out. Her car slides out of the corner and goes off track a moment later.
Whoa! What a disaster!
Zuikaku's tire popped! And she's out of the course!
Essex manages to avoid Zuikaku's car as it veers off and pulls ahead!
*sigh*... Yeah, I figured it would go like this.
Though we're up to second place, the joy is short lived.
Collett, her face glued to the screen this whole time, frowns gravely and talks to Essex.
Essex, our tires... They're on their last legs too.
If we push them any further, our lap times could be the least of our worries – they might even burst.
I know. But if we go to the pit now, Enterprise will only widen her lead.
But then, an announcement from the race organizers suddenly rings out through the course.
VSC.
Virtual Safety Car deployed.
VSC?!
It's because of the debris left after Zuikaku's tires burst earlier!
It's the perfect time for a pit stop.
If I go in now, we can minimize the time loss!
Everyone's eyes are on me now.
One question remains: who will run the final stretch of the race?
After a moment, Essex finally speaks.
Commander, you're up!
I believe in you!
The gap's almost closed. I know you can make it to first place!
This is what we worked so hard for... Commander, you're the only one that can do this!

sequence: Scorching Summer Wavechasers  12 A Millisecond Miracle

scripts.say: We complete our final pit stop during the VSC's forced slowdown.
Tire changes, refueling, and driver tag-in are all done in record time.
A perfect pit stop!
Position confirmed! We're still in second place!
Enterprise just finished her pit stop, too!
Roger that.
VSC ends, and the race resumes.
The final showdown for first place has begun!
Enterprise has taken the lead, but hot on her heels is the Commander, who has just returned to the driver's seat!
There's only a razor-thin margin between them. The whole six-hour rally is sure to be decided in this final moment!
Enterprise drives patiently and defensively.
She doesn't make any wasteful moves or burn through her tires unnecessarily.
Even getting one meter closer is a Herculean feat.
They're gaining on me... That isn't Essex driving, is it?
It's my honey~ You're gonna get overtaken~
Feeling the pressure yet, Enty?
Yeah... I am.
But I won't let the Commander get past me.
With each lap, my muscle memory of the track gradually returns to me.
Where I can brake later than usual, where I can push the throttle harder...
Countless lessons learned through trial and error lead me to the perfect line.
Commander, Enterprise has a habit of being gentler on her tires through the sixth corner.
Her exit speed is lower as a result, so try making a move on the next lap.
I take a deep breath. Sure enough, the opportunity comes on the next lap.
As soon as I have traction coming out of the corner, I punch it earlier than on previous laps.
My car shoots out of the bend, rapidly closing the gap between us.
Just before the next brake zone, I instantly go for a wider angle before cutting back to an inside line.
Enterprise's course correction comes just a split second too late, giving me an opening to barge in front of her.
It's happening!
The Commander has overtaken her!
We have a new leader!
Whoa, my honey really did it!
I'm amazed.
But the race isn't over yet.
Over the next few laps, Enterprise calmly stays behind, ready to pounce on any mistake I make.
The clock ticks away.
As the display signals the start of the final lap, there's still only half a car's length between us.
It's the final lap!
The Sunset Avenue 6-Hour Endurance Rally enters its last spurt!
Who will take the championship? Enterprise, or the Commander?!
They're practically glued together!
The gap is only two meters at most. Don't let her pass you!
But our tires are reaching their limit...
Two high-speed corners left. We'll have to slow down for them.
But if I slow down, I won't be able to stop Enterprise.
She'll slow down, too... You swapped tires at the same time, remember?
No – I know Enterprise, and she'll accelerate into the turn hoping she can keep control.
This is her only opportunity to win – she'll risk going off the track if it means a chance of victory.
The two final high-speed corners lie ahead.
Enterprise sticks to me, ready to stake it all on this as well.
What incredible speed! They're never going to slow down!
This is the final struggle for the championship!
We slam on the brakes simultaneously right before things get dangerous on the curve.
Then, in perfect sync – before we've even straightened out our steering wheels – we go full throttle again.
In that split second, if we'd pushed even a little harder, we would have rolled off the course.
Commander and Enterprise have navigated the corner perfectly in cars that are on the brink of collapse!
Neither giving an inch, nor going off the track!
Right now, they're roaring toward the checkered flag together!
They crossed at the same time!
I can't tell who won!
The crowd erupts into cheers.
A final result is displayed on the giant screen.
The winner is Team {car2026}!
With a lead of just 0.001 seconds!
Let's hear those cheers, everybody! The Commander is the champion!
BEEP! Championship victory confirmed. Ceremony unlocked!
The massive dome suddenly lights up after having been dormant throughout the race.
System jacked. Error XIII, the stage is yours.
A giant pixel-art cat face appears at the top of the dome.
Golden bubbles begin to float about, each one containing the name of a team member.
{playername}, Essex, Bennington, Harrison, John Rodgers, Collett, Error XIII...
Team {car2026}! We are the champions, my friends!
I knew you could win this, Commander!
We won! We're the champions!
You were incredible, Commander!
Collett? Did you prepare all of that?
Mhm. I did it just for this. Can't only let it celebrate on the dashboard, right?
Fair enough. This is OUR victory, after all!
Our trophy gleams brightly on the podium.
Essex and I reach for it together, and we raise it high with the rest of the team.
Cheers erupt from the stands again, as if the whole city is celebrating our victory.
Let's hear another round of applause for our winning team!
Hello, everybody! Thank you for watching the pre-race special for the Sunset Avenue 6-Hour Endurance Rally!
I'm today's guest MC, Guam!
Next to me is our guest correspondent, Alfredo Oriani!
Good evening to everybody watching!
Alfredo and I are here to bring you the latest scoop on this race's teams!
>Front-row seats obtained!
>It's finally starting! Tell us about it!
>Waiting for the inside scoop here...
>Hurry it up already!
>Anyone want drinks and popcorn, nya?
Enthusiasm crackles in the air! Let's see here... Ooh! The day's first scoop is a hot one!
Details of the first racing team popped up on the monitor, accompanied by flashy visual effects.
First up, we have a top contender for the championship: Zuikaku!
As a driver, she's armed with both top-tier talent and precise control. Her control through corners is off the charts!
Wow! So what I'm hearing is, Zuikaku's technique is nearly flawless.
Her speed and routing through corners are truly world-class.
If she can capitalize on others' mistakes, she has a strong chance of winning the top prize!
Interesting! Let's take a look at her next rival, Enterprise!
>Who??
>This is gonna be EPIC!
>An iconic moment in the making!
>Enty is the ultimate jack of all trades!
Hm? Ooh... She has no weaknesses to speak of! After all, she's the best in the world!
Ahem... However!
A race can change at any given moment, so there's no telling who might win until it's over! Isn't that right?
>She's trying way too hard to spin this.
>That's Enterprise for you...
>I hope Zuikaku isn't watching the stream...
>Isn't that fascinating?
Yeah! Like Alfredo said, we'll never know who won until it's over!
Let's take a look at our last piece of info... Oh? An incredible team has appeared in the open tryout slot!
>Is it a new pro?
>Open tryout slot? Are you serious?
>Is it my Owner? It's gotta be!
>Wow, who knew they'd have such a crazy surprise in store?
>Whoever it is, I hope they enjoy the race to the fullest.
Heheh, some of you in the chat have already figured it out!
We don't have full details on the team just yet, but I promise, we'll reveal the answer next episode!
Yep! If you wanna know more, don't miss our live coverage!
Don't forget to like and subscribe! See you all next time!
>Bye!
>Quit acting like a riddler and spill the beans!
>Thanks for the stream, Guam!
>I'm so hot right now...♥
Bristol checked and double-checked the supplies list in the waiting room. After one last check, she snapped the file shut with a grim expression on her face.
...It's not here.
Seeing her distress, William D. Porter stopped labelling boxes and approached her.
Is something missing?
The container with 1.2 tons of race event collab chocolate bars is gone! It was supposed to be right here.
Maybe it was taken somewhere else?
Not a chance. I checked three times, and there's no record of it being received anywhere else.
Bristol could not overlook this affront.
This isn't just missing inventory! This is a chocolate heist we're dealing with!
Whoa, whoa, whoa! Let's not jump the gun! Maybe someone made a mistake!
Whatever the case, we need to investigate! Let's start questioning people!
The two of them rushed out of the paddock and onto the venue, where they saw Vicksburg in the middle of a promotional photo shoot.
Sorry to bother you, Vicksburg, but have you seen any big vehicles leaving this paddock?
Um... A large one? I did see a truck heading that way.
Ah. The container did have an official logo on it.
I don't think anyone requested to take one of the trucks out today... Maybe that's our culprit?
It's looking rather likely! There's nowhere else that would even use such a gigantic chocolate bar... We're dealing with a highly coordinated and carefully planned heist!
We need to hurry and find it before it's too late!
William vaulted over onto Happy D, which happened to be parked nearby. Its engine roared to life.
Happy D, supersonic dash!
And so, she rushed out, kicking up dust as she sped off towards the coastal road.
Pressed low to Happy D, Porter caught up to the truck she was chasing after.
Hello, yes, you there in the truck! Pull over right now! Pull over, I say!
The truck slowed down and parked on the side of the road. When the side window rolled down, Kashiro's face came into view.
Oh?
Huh?! Y-you're the chocolate thief?!
Chocolate... thief? What?
This truck just has car parts in it, though? That's what the label on the box says, at least.
Label?
William got into the trailer and examined the boxes, which were indeed labelled "car parts."
But the handwriting was a little squiggly and messy, with a smiley face on the side as well.
Huh?
These are the labels I put on them yesterday. I must have mixed up "chocolate bar" and "car parts"...
After a couple of seconds of silence, Kashino blinked and spoke up.
I see! Well, that does explain the sweet scent I was getting this whole ride~♪
While everybody organized their gear in the maintenance room, Bennington burst in, pushing a cloth-covered whiteboard.
After wheeling it in front of the group, she yanked the cloth off of it.
